result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but two visual defects stand out: the horizontally scrollable category chip row and the 'Fastest near you' carousel lack right-edge fade or padding cues beyond simple clipping (acceptable per scope), however the ramen card's heart icon and the pizza card's heart icon sit on dark imagery with low contrast in one case, and the promo banner's decorative circles clip awkwardly. Main genuine issues: the '€0 delivery' badge and heart button overlap the ramen image without issue, but the status bar time/icons are fine. Real findings: (1) the partially visible chip at the right edge of the category row is expected behavior and excluded; (2) the clipped 'Trattoria Piccol...' title is excluded; (3) the bottom-cut pizza card is excluded. Remaining genuine issues: the notification bell's red dot badge has no count and floats detached, and the green promo banner text 'Use code TALLINNN3...' is fine. On closer inspection, the only true visual defects are minor: the heart icon button on the ramen card uses a dark translucent background that blends into the dark image (low affordance), and the category row shows a sliver of a next chip with no scroll indicator which is expected. Therefore only minor styling issues are reported.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card uses a near-black translucent circle on a already dark photo, making the control hard to perceive as tappable.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent semi-transparent white or solid brand-colored background for heart buttons so they remain visible on both dark and light imagery.

issues.description: The notification bell badge is a small red dot with no numeric count and no visible label, which may be missed by users with low vision and provides no information about notification quantity.
issues.suggestion: Either show a count inside the badge or ensure the dot meets minimum touch/visual size guidelines, and add an accessible label such as 'Notifications, unread'.
